name: clps-lunar-browser
description: CLPS Lunar Mission Browser — NASA-grounded Earth → Moon → Lunar Surface → CLPS dynamic environment

scripts.assets:all: npm run assets:fetch && npm run assets:derive && npm run assets:manifest
scripts.dev:api: npm run build:ai && npm run dev -w services/api
scripts.dev: concurrently -n api,web,research -c cyan,magenta,yellow "npm run dev:api" "npm run dev:web" "npm run dev:research"
scripts.build: npm run build:ai && npm run build -w services/api && npm run build -w apps/web
scripts.typecheck: npm run build:ai && npm run typecheck -w services/api && npm run typecheck -w apps/web
